name: TypeScript / JS
exports_detected: export { Name } and export type { Name } re-exports
export * as Namespace from '...' wildcard namespace
description: Regex-based export detection that strips comments and handles re-exports. Resolves barrel files and wildcard re-exports when a file resolver is provided. Skips .d.ts and test files.

detection_rules.title: Direct export declarations
detection_rules.description: Matches export keyword followed by a declaration. Handles async, abstract modifiers.

detection_rules.title: Default exports
detection_rules.description: export default class/function with optional name. Keyword-like identifiers (new, true, null) are excluded.
detection_rules.example_code:
export default class MyApp {}
export default function handler() {}

detection_rules.title: Named re-exports
detection_rules.description: export { Name, OldName as NewName } and export type { MyType }. Aliases use the target name.
detection_rules.example_code:
export { Foo, Bar as Baz } from './module';
export type { MyType } from './types';

detection_rules.title: Wildcard re-exports
detection_rules.description: export * as Namespace captures the namespace name. export * from '...' resolves via file resolver if provided.
detection_rules.example_code:
export * as Utils from './utils';
export * from './helpers';

test_pattern_examples.explanation: Type declaration files — skipped (no runtime exports)

## Purpose

Handles JWT authentication.

## Public API

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `authenticate` | `(token: string)` | `User \| null` | Validates bearer token |
| `AuthService` | — | — | Auth service class |
| `TokenType` | — | — | Token string type alias |

| Date | Change |
|------|--------|
| 2026-01-01 | Initial |
caveats: Re-exports from external npm packages are not followed across package boundaries.
Conditional exports in package.json are not parsed.
Dynamic re-exports (export default computed) may not be captured.
Module augmentation (declare module '...') is not detected.
